note: Stone County has base zoning districts (A-1, RR-1, C-1, etc. per its 2014 regulations). Its GIS zoning theme sits in the county's Stone_Assessor_Data service, which answers 'Token Required' (login-protected), so it cannot be queried. Kimberling City's zoning map is an image-only PDF (viewer-only). Branson's ZoningMap_Nov2022 layer is queryable but covers only Branson city limits and returns 1 feature around the county sample point, so it fails validation.
